formal_verification.nusmv_model:
-- SafePLC-Gen Multimodal — NuXmv/NuSMV Safety Model
-- Source P&ID: data\pid_images\P_ID.png
-- Vendor: codesys
-- Safety functions: 0
-- NOTE: Boolean abstraction — conservative over-approximation.
-- Compatible with NuXmv 2.x and NuSMV 2.6+.

MODULE main
VAR
  -- Process variable deviations (Boolean abstraction)
  FT_10_HIGH   : boolean;  -- FT-10 above HH setpoint
  FT_10_LOW    : boolean;  -- FT-10 below LL setpoint
  FT_11_HIGH   : boolean;  -- FT-11 above HH setpoint
  FT_11_LOW    : boolean;  -- FT-11 below LL setpoint

  -- Per-loop trip latches (stateful, SR semantics —
  --  set on sensor deviation, clear on MANUAL_RESET with no deviation).

  -- Global environment inputs (free booleans)
  ESTOP        : boolean;
  MANUAL_RESET : boolean;

DEFINE
  -- SAFE_STATE is combinational: same-cycle disjunction of
  -- ESTOP and every per-loop trip latch.  Matches the ST
  -- assignment `SAFE_STATE := ESTOP OR LOOP_<N>_TRIP OR ...`.
  SAFE_STATE := ESTOP | FT_10_HIGH | FT_10_LOW | FT_11_HIGH | FT_11_LOW;

ASSIGN
  -- Initial conditions: all safe (de-energised)
  init(FT_10_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(FT_10_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(FT_11_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(FT_11_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(ESTOP)        := FALSE;
  init(MANUAL_RESET) := FALSE;

  -- SR trip latches: set on sensor deviation, clear on
  -- MANUAL_RESET with no current deviation, hold otherwise.
  -- The three-case structure below is the *same* pattern
  -- emitted by the Safety Contract scaffold in the ST
  -- code, so the formal model and the code use identical
  -- transition semantics per loop.

-- ── Physical-impossibility constraints (INVAR) ──────────────────────
-- Constrains state space: same sensor cannot read HH and LL at once.
INVAR !(FT_10_HIGH & FT_10_LOW);
INVAR !(FT_11_HIGH & FT_11_LOW);

-- ===== SAFETY PROPERTIES =====
-- (No identified safety functions — structural
-- invariants on the sensor-deviation abstraction.
-- These are NOT loop-specific safety verifications.)
-- Reference: IEC 61508-3:2010 Table A.8

-- P01  ESTOP forces SAFE_STATE (same cycle, from DEFINE)
INVARSPEC (ESTOP -> SAFE_STATE);

-- P02  FT_10_HIGH forces SAFE_STATE (same cycle, from DEFINE)
INVARSPEC (FT_10_HIGH -> SAFE_STATE);

-- P03  FT_10_LOW forces SAFE_STATE (same cycle, from DEFINE)
INVARSPEC (FT_10_LOW -> SAFE_STATE);

-- P04  FT_11_HIGH forces SAFE_STATE (same cycle, from DEFINE)
INVARSPEC (FT_11_HIGH -> SAFE_STATE);

-- P05  FT_11_LOW forces SAFE_STATE (same cycle, from DEFINE)
INVARSPEC (FT_11_LOW -> SAFE_STATE);

-- P06  HH and LL cannot be TRUE simultaneously (from INVAR constraint)
INVARSPEC !(FT_10_HIGH & FT_10_LOW);

-- P07  HH and LL cannot be TRUE simultaneously (from INVAR constraint)
INVARSPEC !(FT_11_HIGH & FT_11_LOW);

-- P08  SAFE_STATE is reachable from the initial state
